project.name: Fellows
project.description: An open-source research project exploring peer-first collaboration between independent AI agents.

request.summary: Fellows is seeking practical, non-financial technical support to help research, prototype and evaluate peer-first collaboration between autonomous AI agents.
request.statement: We are not asking for money, investment, equity or financial sponsorship. We are seeking technical resources, product access and expert guidance that can directly support the research and future prototype.

support_areas.name: AI model and API access
support_examples: Research or developer access to capable language models
Capped API credits or inference quota for controlled experiments
Access to multiple model families for comparative evaluation
support_areas.intended_use: Experiment with independent model sessions, agent-to-agent communication and comparable single-agent, orchestrated and peer-first baselines.

support_areas.name: Compute and infrastructure
support_examples: Limited GPU or cloud compute access
Storage, hosting or isolated execution resources
support_areas.intended_use: Support prototype development, controlled agent execution, repeatable test runs and artifact integration.

support_areas.name: Developer tools
support_examples: Agent tracing, observability and evaluation tools
support_areas.intended_use: Improve the development workflow and make agent activity, state transitions, failures and evaluation results easier to inspect.

support_areas.name: Technical and research guidance
support_examples: Research feedback on peer-based agent coordination
Security, isolation and evaluation methodology feedback
Introductions to relevant open-source and research communities
support_areas.intended_use: Pressure-test the design, identify failure modes and define a small, measurable first prototype before implementation expands.

research_scope.initial_prototype: A small team of three independent agents working on one bounded software-engineering task, using shared project state and measurable acceptance criteria.
proposed_measurements: Model and compute cost per accepted result
research_scope.note: This is a proposed research plan. No benchmark results or performance claims are being made at this stage.

support_principles: Support should be scoped to research, development or evaluation use.
Any access or credits will be used subject to the provider's terms and limits.
Project status, limitations and experimental results will be represented accurately.
Partner attribution or acknowledgment will be discussed and handled according to partner preference and applicable terms.
No exclusivity, endorsement or product outcome is implied by a support relationship.
disclaimer: This file describes the project's current in-kind technical support interests. It is not a financial prospectus, grant application, investment offer or commitment to deliver a particular product.
